summary: External standards pressure for the portable handoff layer: keep digest-bound subjects, explicit inputs, immutable revisions, reproducible timestamp discipline, and standard runtime/resource metadata without claiming compliance.

sources.title: SLSA specification v1.2
sources.pressure: Provenance should describe artifact, builder/process, and inputs.

sources.title: SLSA v1.1 levels
sources.pressure: Provenance existence is only a starting point; promotion needs stronger guarantees.

sources.title: in-toto and SLSA
sources.pressure: Use statement/predicate-style digest-bound subjects rather than path-name trust.

sources.title: Reproducible Builds
sources.pressure: Independent verification depends on source-to-artifact correspondence.

sources.title: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH specification
sources.pressure: Avoid uncontrolled timestamp entropy in portable handoff archives.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Resource semantic conventions
sources.pressure: Runtime identity fields should map to stable resource semantics where possible.
